title: Launch runway: staging lanes, regional cutovers, and SLA escalation playbook
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Create a single operational playbook that defines: (1) staging lanes (dev -> int -> canary -> staging -> prod) and explicit gating for runtime, console, and API changes; (2) a regional cutover timetable with blackout windows per region and a minimal-impact fallback plan; (3) an SLA escalation matrix (who to page, thresholds, and automated remediation rules); and (4) telemetry dashboards & rollout gates tied to OKR health signals. This ticket coordinates cross-team inputs (ENG/Design/SRE/Support) and will produce: a confluence runbook, a canary orchestration checklist, a shared dashboard (Datadog/Grafana) template, and a rollout timeline artifact for stakeholder sign-off.
comments: 2026-03-02 - Aisha Kumar: Kickoff meeting summary. Agreed scope and stakeholders: Eng (runtime, infra), Console PM, UX, SRE, Support. Action: ENG to surface DB/migrations that need hard cutovers; SRE to define acceptable latency/error thresholds for canary gating.

2026-03-04 - Ben Park: Drafted staging lane definitions and gating criteria. Proposed automatic rollback if 5xx rate > 0.5% sustained for 5 minutes or P95 latency degrades > 30% vs baseline. Flagged possible false-positive noise for short spikes — asked SRE for smoothing window recommendations.

2026-03-05 - Mei Chen (SRE): Recommended 10-minute aggregation window for gating, with separate alert tier (informational -> severity 2 -> severity 1). Documented alert recipients per region. Added link to preliminary alert runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/launch/runbook-alerting

2026-03-07 - Design review (DES-214): UX provided banner/notice templates and a Snackbar pattern for staged rollouts in Console. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/launch-banner-playbook. Design requests copy approval from Legal for EMEA-specific wording.

2026-03-09 - ENG-4982 owner (Rajat Singh): Kernel-selection change needs a canary on Dedicated. Estimates 3 days work to enable dual-kernel canary path. Blocker for synchronized runtime/api cutover in EU region — added to dependencies list.

2026-03-10 - Ben Park: Consolidated canary matrix: traffic %. Proposed 2% traffic for 30 minutes -> 10% for 60 minutes -> 50% for 2 hours -> full. Each step requires green telemetry and no regression on evaluation prompt set. Linked eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/canary-suite/pull/82
